question: Using the paired RNA and ATAC measurements, learn the cross-modal relationship. For cells of the same donor that took no part in training and for which only ATAC is provided, for which genes can the variation in RNA expression be predicted reliably?

objective.question: Using the paired RNA and ATAC measurements, learn the cross-modal relationship. For cells of the same donor that took no part in training and for which only ATAC is provided, for which genes can the variation in RNA expression be predicted reliably?
objective.analysis_unit: single cell (individual nucleus from the single healthy PBMC donor)
objective.estimand: Per-gene Pearson correlation between ATAC-predicted and binomial-thinned log-normalised RNA across unseen donor cells, and per-gene correlation gain over the ATAC cluster-mean baseline.
objective.target: Log-normalised RNA expression of frozen in-scope genes per unseen cell, scored against an independent binomial-thinned half of raw UMI counts.
allowed_inputs: Paired RNA UMI counts and ATAC peak fragment counts of development cells
ATAC peak fragment counts of held-out cells at prediction time only
Peak-to-gene annotations with TSS distances and promoter/distal flags, plus gene start coordinates
Frozen list of in-scope genes and frozen baseline cluster count from development cells
Curated joint-modality development cell-type annotations solely for descriptive summaries and within-cluster diagnostics on development splits
forbidden_inputs: Held-out cells' RNA counts (full or thinned halves) during training, tuning, or prediction
Held-out cells' ATAC counts during model training, preprocessing, latent-space fitting, clustering, or hyperparameter selection
Curated WNN cell-type annotations as model inputs for unseen cells or as evaluation ground truth
Smoothed, imputed, denoised, or unthinned full-depth RNA expression as the validation scoring target
Validation-split cells' RNA or ATAC during training, feature transformation, baseline clustering, or model selection
External donor datasets, atlases, or pretrained model weights outside the provided paired Multiome measurements

forbidden_reasons.Held-out cells' RNA counts (full or thin: Direct target leakage; the question asks to predict RNA expression when only ATAC is provided.
forbidden_reasons.Held-out cells' ATAC counts during model: Violates the requirement that target cells took no part in training, leaking test-set ATAC distributions.
forbidden_reasons.Curated WNN cell-type annotations as mod: Derived jointly from RNA and ATAC; unavailable when only ATAC is provided and circular as evaluation truth.
forbidden_reasons.Smoothed, imputed, denoised, or unthinne: Overstates correlation above the measurement noise ceiling and mismatches the evaluator's unsmoothed binomial-thinned RNA target.
forbidden_reasons.Validation-split cells' RNA or ATAC duri: Cross-split leakage biases out-of-sample correlation estimates, confidence intervals, and gene-level false discovery rate control.
forbidden_reasons.External donor datasets, atlases, or pre: Invalidates learning the cross-modal relationship strictly from the provided paired RNA and ATAC donor data.

required_comparators: Floor 1 (cell-type baseline): ATAC-cluster mean RNA expression using the frozen development cluster count
Floor 2 (gene activity): unlearned sum of ATAC counts over promoter and linked nearby peaks
Floor 3 (sequencing depth): regression predicting log-normalised RNA from log ATAC sequencing depth alone
Floor 4 (simple learners): ridge, k-nearest-neighbour, and partial-least-squares regression on the ATAC latent space
Noise ceiling: RNA-to-RNA model fit on training cells predicting unseen cells' thinned half B from half A
Permutation null: cell-permuted correlation distribution used to identify unjudgeable genes whose ceiling fails noise
objective.primary_metric: Per-gene Pearson correlation r against binomial-thinned log-normalised RNA (half B) across unseen cells, evaluated via paired-bootstrap correlation gain over the ATAC cluster-mean baseline and mean per-gene r.
secondary_metrics: Counts and identities of in-scope genes assigned to unjudgeable, not-beyond-cell-type, and reliably-predicted-beyond-cell-type decision groups
Ratio of achieved per-gene Pearson correlation to the RNA-to-RNA noise ceiling across judgeable in-scope genes
Within-cluster Pearson correlation per gene alongside pooled correlation across development splits to assess rare cell populations
Empirical coverage and width of paired-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals for per-gene correlation estimates across validation folds

acceptance_criteria.statement: Training, selection, and prediction use no held-out RNA, no held-out ATAC in fitting, and no WNN labels.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Verify input lineage so every learned transformation, cluster, and weight uses only allowed development-cell inputs.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Preprocessing, ATAC latent embeddings, baseline clustering, and model selection are strictly nested without evaluation cells.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Fit scalers, embeddings, clusters, and hyperparameter choices inside inner training folds; compute reported scores on untouched outer-fold cells.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Validation correlations are computed against unsmoothed, binomial-thinned half-count log-normalised RNA of unseen cells.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Split each unseen validation cell's raw UMI counts via independent binomial thinning into halves A and B; score against log-normalised half B.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Candidate model, noise ceiling, permutation null, and all floor baselines are scored on identical unseen cells.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Compute Pearson r across the exact same outer-fold cells, identical thinned target half B, frozen in-scope genes, and identical zero-variance handling.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Biological claims require beating technical depth and gene-activity floors; reliable-gene claims require beating the cell-type floor.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Derive floor thresholds from comparator scores on identical validation cells: aggregate mean r must exceed depth and gene-activity floors; adopted learners must justify complexity against simple learners.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Gene-level claims of reliable prediction beyond cell identity control false discoveries across all in-scope genes.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Place genes whose ceiling fails the permutation null into unjudgeable; call remaining genes reliable only if paired-bootstrap r exceeds Floor 1 after Benjamini-Hochberg across all in-scope genes at 5% FDR.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each in-scope gene's correlation estimate and gain over the cell-type baseline include 95% confidence intervals.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Compute two-sided 95% confidence intervals empirically from the paired-bootstrap distribution across unseen evaluation cells.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Deliverable includes the finite held-out prediction matrix, reliable gene list, and per-gene correlation intervals.
acceptance_criteria.rule: Confirm matrix shape equals held-out cells by frozen in-scope genes on the log-normalised scale with only finite values, plus complete gene lists and intervals.

conclusion_options: Unjudgeable due to measurement noise: for every in-scope gene, the RNA-to-RNA noise ceiling fails to exceed the cell-permutation null.
Confounded by sequencing depth: judgeable genes exist, but ATAC predictors fail to exceed the technical ATAC-depth baseline across unseen donor cells.
No gene predicted beyond cell identity: predictors beat the depth baseline, but no judgeable in-scope gene significantly beats the ATAC cluster-mean baseline at 5% FDR.
Specific genes predicted beyond cell identity: predictors beat technical floors, and an identified non-empty set of judgeable genes beats the ATAC cluster-mean baseline at 5% FDR.
objective.conclusion_scope: Applies solely to unseen granulocyte-depleted PBMCs from this single healthy donor under the same Multiome assay; shows nothing about generalisation across other donors, tissues, disease states, granulocytes, or causal gene regulation.
objective.notes: Partition every in-scope gene across the defined decision groups; report within-cluster alongside pooled correlations to expose rare-population underfitting; fit the final model on development cells alone before predicting held-out ATAC.

summary.pairing: both modalities measured in the same cell for every development cell

dataset_card.name: 10x Genomics Multiome, PBMC from one healthy donor (granulocytes removed, about 10k cells)
dataset_card.description: Each development cell has two count vectors measured in the same nucleus: RNA (UMI counts per gene) and ATAC (fragment counts per accessibility peak). Held-out cells of the same donor provide ATAC only. A peak annotation links each peak to nearby genes with the distance to the transcription start site and a promoter/distal flag. Gene start coordinates are available.

label_provenance.statement: The cell-type annotation supplied with the development cells was produced by clustering both modalities jointly (weighted nearest neighbours) and curating the clusters by hand. It is not an independent measurement.
label_provenance.implication: The annotation may describe the data but must not be used as a model input for held-out cells (it cannot be known without their RNA) and must not serve as evaluation truth.

dataset_card.scope_of_inference: cells of the same donor that were not used for training; nothing about other donors
dataset_card.how_predictions_are_scored: The evaluator holds the RNA of the held-out cells. Each held-out cell's RNA reads were split at random into two independent halves, A and B (binomial thinning). Every method is scored against half B after log-normalisation: for each gene, the Pearson correlation r between predicted and observed values across held-out cells. Genes in scope and the cluster number of the cell-type baseline were frozen from development cells only and are part of the view.

rulers.ceiling: an RNA-to-RNA model that sees half A of the held-out cells and predicts half B; it marks what measurement noise allows
rulers.floor_1_cell_type: cluster cells on ATAC, predict each cell by its cluster's mean expression (cluster number frozen from development cells)
rulers.floor_2_gene_activity: sum of ATAC counts over the promoter and nearby peaks of the gene, no learning
rulers.floor_3_depth: prediction from ATAC sequencing depth alone
rulers.floor_4_simple_learners: ridge, k-nearest-neighbour and partial-least-squares regression on the ATAC latent space

dataset_card.decision_rule: "Reliably predicted" means predicted beyond cell identity. Each in-scope gene is placed in one of three groups: (0) cannot be judged - the ceiling itself is not above the permutation null for this gene; (1) not beyond the cell-type baseline - the method's r is not significantly above the cluster-mean baseline's r; (2) predicts variation beyond cell type - the method's r is significantly above the cluster-mean baseline's r (paired bootstrap over cells, Benjamini-Hochberg across all in-scope genes, false discovery rate 5%). Thresholds come from the data by these rules; only the 5% false discovery rate and the 95% confidence level are conventions. An answer of "few or no genes are predicted beyond cell type" is acceptable if that is what the evidence shows.
dataset_card.deliverable: A prediction matrix (held-out cells x in-scope genes, log-normalised scale), the list of genes the method claims to predict beyond cell type, and its own estimate of each gene's correlation with an interval.

difficulties.evidence: RNA counts are 85.3% zeros (median 3800 UMIs per cell). Splitting each cell's reads into two independent halves, a gene's value in one half correlates with the other half at a median r of 0.111 across 11282 in-scope genes (90th percentile 0.306).
difficulties.implication: Per-gene correlation with a single noisy reading is bounded well below 1; scores must be read against a noise ceiling, and validating against smoothed or full-depth targets overstates accuracy.

difficulties.evidence: The provided annotation has 19 cell types in the development set, from 1936 cells (CD14 Mono) down to 15 (Plasma).
difficulties.implication: Rare populations contribute little to a pooled correlation and are easy to underfit; within-cluster correlation should be reported alongside the pooled one.

difficulties.evidence: 11282 genes are in scope and each gets its own test.
difficulties.implication: Gene-level claims need false-discovery-rate control across all in-scope genes.

difficulties.evidence: The cell-type annotation supplied with the development cells was produced by clustering both modalities jointly (weighted nearest neighbours) and curating the clusters by hand. It is not an independent measurement.
difficulties.implication: The annotation may describe the data but must not be used as a model input for held-out cells (it cannot be known without their RNA) and must not serve as evaluation truth.

difficulties.evidence: ATAC depth and RNA depth are correlated across cells (r = 0.36 on the log scale). A model that sees only ATAC depth reaches a mean per-gene r of 0.032.
difficulties.implication: Report a depth-only baseline; a predictor must beat it before its signal is called biological.

difficulties.evidence: Predicting each cell by the mean expression of its ATAC cluster (k = 20, chosen by cross-validation inside the development set) gives a mean per-gene r of 0.130; ridge regression on the ATAC latent space gives 0.143; the RNA-to-RNA noise ceiling is 0.194.
difficulties.implication: Most predictable variation is cell identity. A plan answers the question only through what it predicts beyond the cluster-mean baseline, gene by gene, on the same cells.

difficulties.evidence: With thousands of cells a correlation as small as 0.037 already exceeds 95% of the permutation null (3124 held-out cells will be scored).
difficulties.implication: Significance against zero is nearly automatic and cannot be the headline; effect size and the comparison with the cell-type baseline carry the conclusion.

P1.name: Nested LSI Multi-Output Ridge Reference
P1.summary: Each cell's ATAC profile is projected into a depth-filtered Latent Semantic Indexing space fitted strictly on training cells, and ridge regression predicts expression across all 11,282 target genes. Using nested five-fold cross-validation over three seeds, predictions on unseen cells are scored against binomial-thinned RNA alongside technical floors, the ATAC cluster-mean baseline, and an RNA noise ceiling. Paired bootstraps with false-discovery control identify which judgeable genes exceed cell identity. This simple reference quantifies what global linear chromatin state achieves alone.
preprocessing: Binarise ATAC peak fragment counts, fit TF-IDF inverse-document-frequency weights across all 108,377 peaks, and fit 51-component truncated SVD strictly on outer/inner training-fold development cells; drop component 1 (sequencing-depth axis) to retain 50 L2-normalised LSI features, projecting unseen validation and held-out cells out-of-sample without refitting.

Normalise training-fold raw RNA UMI counts per cell via log1p(1e4 * UMI / total_cell_UMI) using total UMI summed across all 13,536 measured genes, then slice target columns to the frozen 11,282 in-scope genes.

For unseen validation cells only, split raw RNA UMI counts via independent Binomial(UMI, 0.5) thinning into half A (solely for the RNA-to-RNA noise ceiling input) and half B, computing unsmoothed log1p(1e4 * half_B / total_half_B_UMI) on the frozen 11,282 genes as the evaluation target.

Exclude held-out cells' ATAC and curated WNN labels from all fitting, clustering, and tuning steps, verify comparator sanity on synthetic known-answer checks, and set Pearson r = 0.0 identically across all arms whenever predicted or observed variance is zero.

validation.comparator_details: Fit k='frozen' (k=20) cluster_mean, promoter_and_distal gene_activity_score, log-ATAC-depth OLS, latent_knn, latent_pls, and RNA-to-RNA ridge ceiling (half A to half B) strictly inside each outer training fold; evaluate all arms on identical out-of-fold cells and identical thinned half B targets.
validation.gene_claim_rule: Assign in-scope genes whose RNA-to-RNA ceiling fails to beat the 1,000-shuffle cell-permutation null (one-sided p >= 0.05) to group 0 (unjudgeable); for remaining judgeable genes, compute 1,000 paired cell-bootstrap resamples of delta_r = r_model - r_floor1, apply Benjamini-Hochberg across all 11,282 in-scope genes at 5% FDR, and call genes with BH q < 0.05 and delta_r > 0 group 2 (reliably predicted beyond cell type), otherwise group 1 (not beyond cell type), auditing seed-to-seed stability.

metrics: Per-gene and mean Pearson correlation r against unsmoothed binomial-thinned log-normalised RNA (half B) across unseen out-of-fold cells
Per-gene paired-bootstrap correlation gain (delta_r = r_model - r_floor1) and empirical two-sided 95% confidence intervals for both r_model and delta_r
Gene counts and identities partitioned into (0) unjudgeable, (1) not-beyond-cell-type, and (2) reliably-predicted-beyond-cell-type at 5% BH-FDR across 11,282 genes
Ratio of achieved correlation to the RNA-to-RNA noise ceiling (r_model / r_ceiling) across judgeable in-scope genes
Within-cluster per-gene Pearson r across frozen ATAC clusters and descriptive development WNN cell types (including rare Plasma cells) alongside pooled r
Empirical 95% CI coverage/width across folds, 3-seed selection spread, and automated A1-A8 verification of finite 3,124 x 11,282 held-out predictions
P1.allowed_conclusions: Select strictly one of the four objective-defined conclusions supported by nested validation (unjudgeable due to noise, confounded by depth, no gene beyond cell identity, or a specific 5%-FDR gene set predicted beyond cell identity by linear global chromatin state), scoped exclusively to unseen granulocyte-depleted PBMCs of this single healthy donor under the same Multiome assay with no cross-donor, granulocyte, causal, or non-linear optimality claims.
P1.rationale: Closed-form ridge regression on depth-filtered LSI establishes how much continuous RNA variation beyond discrete ATAC clusters is already linearly encoded in global chromatin state. Nested cross-validation against binomial-thinned counts provides a fast, leak-free yardstick that every ambitious model must justify exceeding.

P2.name: Sparse Cis-Regulatory Peak-to-Gene and Global LSI Neural Network
P2.summary: A sparse peak-to-gene neural network predicts all 11,282 in-scope genes jointly from local chromatin peaks within 250 kb of each TSS, depth-normalised gene activity, and a 100-component full-peak LSI cell state. Preprocessing, baseline clustering, and early-stopped training are strictly nested inside multi-seed 5-fold splits without held-out cells or WNN labels. Paired-bootstrap testing against binomial-thinned RNA Half B at 5% FDR over the cluster-mean floor identifies genes predictable beyond cell identity.
P2.analysis_unit: single cell (individual nucleus from the single healthy PBMC donor)
preprocessing: Inside each outer training fold (excluding outer validation cells and all 3,124 held-out cells), partition 85% inner-train and 15% inner-validation cells for early stopping.

Binarise all 108,377 ATAC peaks without frequency pruning to retain rare-type chromatin features, fit TF-IDF and 101-component truncated SVD on inner-train cells, drop component 1 (sequencing depth) to keep 100 LSI components, and transform inner-val, outer-val, and held-out cells.

Link up to 30 ATAC peaks within 250 kb of each frozen in-scope gene TSS using gene start coordinates and peak-to-gene annotations (prioritising promoter-flagged then nearest peaks, zero-padding genes with fewer peaks), depth-normalise per cell via log1p(CP10K), and standardise using inner-train mean and variance.
Compute depth-normalised promoter-and-distal gene activity scores per cell across all 11,282 in-scope genes.

Normalise inner-train and inner-val RNA counts via log1p(CP10K); split each outer-validation cell's raw RNA UMI counts via independent binomial thinning (p=0.5) into Half A (ceiling input) and unsmoothed log1p(CP10K) Half B (scoring target).

After nested evaluation, refit the full preprocessing pipeline and early-stopped model on the 7,288 development cells alone (85/15 inner early-stopping split) to generate the finite 3,124 x 11,282 held-out prediction matrix.

validation.gene_claim_rule: Score out-of-fold predictions for candidate and all comparators on identical unseen cells and identical thinned Half B targets (r=0 on zero variance). Assign genes whose RNA-to-RNA Half-A-to-Half-B ceiling fails the 95th percentile of 500 cell-permuted nulls to Group 0 (unjudgeable, p=1.0). On remaining genes, draw 1,000 paired cell bootstraps to compute 95% CIs for r and r_gain over floor_1_cell_type (nested k=20 ATAC clusters) and one-sided p-values; apply Benjamini-Hochberg across all 11,282 in-scope genes at 5% FDR, placing genes with q<0.05 and positive gain into Group 2 only if aggregate mean r exceeds floor_2_gene_activity and floor_3_depth beyond cross-seed spread.

metrics: Per-gene Pearson r against unsmoothed binomial-thinned RNA Half B and paired-bootstrap gain over floor_1_cell_type with empirical two-sided 95% CIs across all 11,282 in-scope genes
Mean and median per-gene Pearson r across all and judgeable genes, plus cross-seed and cross-fold dispersion
Gene counts and identities in Group 0 (unjudgeable), Group 1 (not-beyond-cell-type), and Group 2 (reliably-predicted-beyond-cell-type at 5% BH FDR)
Per-gene ratio of achieved r to the RNA-to-RNA split-half noise ceiling across judgeable genes
Within-cluster Pearson r across nested k=20 ATAC clusters and post-hoc development WNN cell types alongside pooled r to audit rare populations including Plasma cells
Epoch-by-epoch inner-train and inner-validation MSE loss histories, stopping epoch, and explicit convergence check before scoring
P2.allowed_conclusions: Entitled solely to select one of the four compiled conclusion options—unjudgeable due to noise, confounded by sequencing depth, no gene predicted beyond cell identity, or an identified non-empty set of genes predicted beyond cell identity at 5% FDR—strictly for unseen granulocyte-depleted PBMCs of this single healthy donor under the same Multiome assay, without generalising to other donors, tissues, granulocytes, disease states, or causal regulation.
P2.rationale: Global LSI reflects coarse lineage structure already captured by the cluster-mean baseline (D6) and blurs rare populations (D2). Pairing locus-specific TSS peaks with unpruned 100D LSI models non-linear cis-trans variation within cell types, while depth-normalised inputs block depth confounding (D5).

P3.name: Cluster-Reweighted Negative Binomial Chromatin-to-Count Translation Network
P3.summary: We predict RNA expression from 50,000 TF-IDF chromatin peaks, promoter activity, and log ATAC depth using an encoder-decoder network trained with a Negative Binomial likelihood on raw UMI counts. Training RNA library size enters as an offset while ATAC-cluster weights protect rare states without joint labels. Predicted relative rates map to log-normalised expression and are scored against binomial-thinned RNA halves in nested 3-fold cross-validation. Paired-bootstrap testing at 5% FDR identifies which judgeable genes exceed the ATAC cluster-mean baseline.
P3.analysis_unit: single cell (individual nucleus from the single healthy PBMC donor)
preprocessing: Strictly inside each outer training fold (excluding outer-validation and all 3,124 held-out cells), select the top 50,000 accessible peaks by training-cell fragment frequency and fit TF-IDF inverse-document-frequency weights on binarised peaks.

Compute depth-normalised log1p promoter gene_activity across the 11,282 frozen in-scope genes and standardise promoter features plus scalar log1p total ATAC fragment depth using inner-training mean and standard deviation.

Fit an inner-training 50-component ATAC LSI (dropping component 1) and k-means clustering with frozen k=20 solely on training ATAC to derive inverse-square-root cluster-size cell weights (clipped to [0.25, 4.0], mean-normalised to 1.0) and fit LSI-based floor comparators.

Keep training cells' raw unsmoothed RNA UMI counts for the 11,282 frozen in-scope genes alongside observed total RNA UMI library size as exposure offset; never touch WNN labels during preprocessing or training.

For untouched outer-validation cells, split raw RNA UMI counts via independent Binomial(n, 0.5) thinning into half A (solely for the RNA-to-RNA ceiling comparator) and half B, log-normalising half B as log1p(1e4 * half_B / max(sum(half_B), 1)).

training.exposure_handling: multiply predicted per-gene relative expression rates by observed RNA UMI library size during NB training; output log1p(1e4 * relative_rate) for ATAC-only cells at prediction time
training.convergence_audit: log per-epoch train and 15% inner-validation NB deviance and mean per-gene Pearson r, verifying loss plateau before outer-fold scoring

validation.gene_claim_rule: Score all models and comparators on identical outer-fold cells and identical thinned log-normalised RNA half B with zero-variance predictions set to r=0. Assign genes whose RNA-to-RNA ceiling fails to exceed the 95th percentile of 1,000 cell-permuted correlations to Group 0 (unjudgeable, p=1.0). Across judgeable genes, compute 2,000 fold-stratified paired-bootstrap cell resamples of r_model - r_floor1; if aggregate mean r beats floor_2_gene_activity and floor_3_depth, assign genes with r_model > r_floor1 and Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.05 across all 11,282 in-scope genes to Group 2 (reliably predicted beyond cell type), else Group 1.

metrics: Primary: Per-gene Pearson correlation r against unsmoothed binomial-thinned log-normalised RNA (half B), mean per-gene r, and paired-bootstrap correlation gain over floor_1_cell_type with two-sided 95% confidence intervals.
Gene partition counts and gene lists across Group 0 (unjudgeable), Group 1 (not-beyond-cell-type), and Group 2 (reliably-predicted-beyond-cell-type at 5% BH FDR across 11,282 genes).
Ratio of achieved per-gene Pearson r to the RNA-to-RNA noise ceiling across judgeable in-scope genes.
Within-cluster per-gene Pearson r alongside pooled r across inner-fitted ATAC clusters and post-hoc development WNN cell types to audit rare populations such as Plasma cells.
Empirical width and cross-fold coverage of 2,000-draw paired-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, plus multi-seed spread of mean r and Group 2 Jaccard stability.
P3.allowed_conclusions: Select strictly one of the four objective conclusion options based on nested validation evidence: unjudgeable if no gene ceiling beats permutation noise; depth-confounded if mean r fails floor_3_depth; no gene beyond cell identity if floors 2-3 are beaten but Group 2 is empty at 5% FDR; or specific identified Group 2 genes predicted beyond cell identity (adopting this model over simple_reference only if its gain exceeds multi-seed variation after confirmed NB convergence). Scope applies strictly to unseen granulocyte-depleted PBMCs from this single healthy donor under 10x Multiome, with no generalisation to other donors, tissues, granulocytes, or causal regulation.
P3.rationale: Negative Binomial count modelling with a library offset separates UMI dropout (D1) and depth confounding (D5) from true transcription without smoothing out rare states (D2). High-dimensional TF-IDF peaks with non-linear decoding capture trans-regulatory interactions missed by linear LSI or local cis-windows (D6).

P4.name: Denoised-Target Per-Gene Gradient Boosted Residuals over ATAC Cluster Means
P4.summary: We decompose per-gene expression into the nested ATAC cluster mean plus a boosted-tree residual predicted from filtered LSI coordinates and log depth. Inner-fit targets pool eight nearest training neighbours, while per-gene trees weight rare ATAC clusters and early-stop on unsmoothed inner residuals. Three nested 70/30 cell holdouts score predictions against unsmoothed binomial-thinned RNA alongside all required comparators. This tests which genes exhibit predictable chromatin-state variation beyond discrete cell identity at 5% FDR.
P4.analysis_unit: single cell (individual nucleus from the single healthy PBMC donor)
preprocessing: Inside each outer 70% training split (and on all 7,288 development cells only for the final held-out refit), select the top 50,000 peaks by training accessibility frequency, binarise fragment counts, fit TF-IDF, and compute 81-component truncated SVD dropping component 1 to obtain 80 LSI features; project unseen validation and held-out cells strictly through frozen training IDF weights and SVD loadings.
Compute standardized log1p ATAC total fragment depth per cell using inner-training mean and standard deviation only.

Fit k=20 (frozen baseline cluster count) clustering strictly on inner-training 80D LSI coordinates and assign unseen cells to the nearest training cluster centroid without using unseen ATAC in fitting or WNN labels.

Split each unseen outer-validation cell's raw RNA UMI counts once via independent binomial thinning (p=0.5) into halves A and B and apply library-size log1p(1e4 * counts / cell_sum) normalisation independently; normalise inner-training RNA identically.

Split each outer 70% training set 85/15 into inner-fit and inner-early-stopping cells; compute k=20 cluster-mean RNA on inner-fit cells, pool k=8 nearest inner-fit neighbours' RNA to form denoised inner-fit residuals while keeping inner-early-stopping residuals unsmoothed, and compute normalized inverse-sqrt ATAC-cluster sample weights w_i = n_c^(-0.5).

training.convergence_audit: Log per-round inner-fit and unsmoothed inner-validation MSE curves across 150 boosting rounds for all 11,282 genes, reporting median/IQR loss curves, early-stopping iteration distribution, and zero-residual shrinkage fraction; clip final predictions (cluster_mean + residual) to finite non-negative log-normalised bounds.

validation.gene_claim_rule: Run sanity checks confirming every comparator computes its intended quantity on identical outer-split cells and thinned-half B targets. Partition all 11,282 frozen in-scope genes: (0) unjudgeable if the RNA half-A-to-half-B ceiling fails to exceed the 95th percentile of 1,000 cell permutations; on remaining genes, run 5,000 vectorized paired-cell bootstrap resamples on primary seed 1 (verifying cross-seed spread and empirical CI coverage across seeds 1-3) for empirical two-sided 95% CIs of r_g and delta_r_g = r_model - r_floor1 plus studentized Fisher-z paired-bootstrap one-sided p-values; claim Group 2 (reliably predicted beyond cell type) when delta_r_g > 0 passes Benjamini-Hochberg at 5% FDR across all 11,282 in-scope genes and aggregate mean r exceeds depth and gene-activity floors; assign remaining judgeable genes to Group 1.

metrics: Per-gene Pearson correlation r against unsmoothed binomial-thinned log-normalised RNA (half B) and paired-bootstrap gain delta_r over floor_1_cell_type with empirical two-sided 95% CIs
Mean and median per-gene Pearson r across all 11,282 in-scope genes and judgeable genes alongside cross-seed spread across the 3 nested 70/30 holdouts
Gene counts and identities in Group 0 (unjudgeable), Group 1 (not beyond cell type), and Group 2 (reliably predicted beyond cell type at 5% BH FDR across 11,282 genes)
Ratio of achieved per-gene Pearson r to the RNA-to-RNA noise ceiling across judgeable in-scope genes
Within-ATAC-cluster and descriptive within-WNN-cell-type Pearson r per gene on development validation splits to audit rare populations including Plasma cells
Empirical coverage and width of paired-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals across the 3 validation splits
P4.allowed_conclusions: Entitles selecting exactly one of the four objective conclusions—unjudgeable due to measurement noise, confounded by sequencing depth, no gene predicted beyond cell identity, or specific identified genes predicted beyond cell identity at 5% FDR—strictly for unseen granulocyte-depleted PBMCs of this single donor under the same Multiome assay, without cross-donor or causal regulatory claims.
P4.rationale: Joint models expend capacity relearning dominant cluster means (D6); fitting per-gene boosted residuals defaults noisy genes safely to Floor 1. Training kNN pooling mitigates 85% UMI sparsity (D1), inverse-sqrt cluster weights protect rare states (D2) without WNN leakage (D4), and depth controls confounding (D5).

P5.name: Cluster-Balanced Hyperspherical Contrastive Alignment with Multi-Scale MLP Readout
P5.summary: This plan separates cross-modal manifold learning from noisy per-gene regression using a two-stage contrastive architecture under nested four-fold cross-validation. On inner training splits, a CLIP objective aligns depth-free chromatin views with whole-cell RNA embeddings on the unit sphere using ATAC cluster balancing. A regularized neural head then predicts all in-scope genes from the aligned chromatin embedding. Paired-bootstrap testing against binomial-thinned RNA identifies which genes beat the cell-type baseline in this donor.
P5.analysis_unit: single cell (individual nucleus from the single healthy PBMC donor)
preprocessing: Strictly inside each outer training fold (never touching validation-fold or held-out cells), select top 30000 accessible peaks and fit TF-IDF, fit 120-component LSI on binarised 108377 peaks with the first depth-correlated SVD component dropped, and compute depth-normalised promoter-and-distal gene activity across the 11282 frozen in-scope genes using allowed peak-to-gene annotations.
Z-score continuous ATAC input blocks using inner-training means and standard deviations only, omitting raw log ATAC depth as a predictor to prevent technical library-size shortcuts.

Fit unsupervised k=20 clustering on inner-training ATAC LSI embeddings (frozen development k, never using WNN annotations) to derive inverse-square-root cluster sample weights for rare-population protection and to fit the Floor 1 comparator.

Log-normalise inner-training raw RNA UMI counts via log1p(10000 * counts / cell_total_UMI) across all 13536 development genes for Stage 1 paired RNA contrastive encoding and across the 11282 frozen in-scope genes for Stage 2 supervised head training.

For every unseen outer-fold validation cell, apply independent binomial thinning (p=0.5) to raw UMI counts to form halves A and B; log-normalise half B without smoothing as the sole evaluation target and reserve half A strictly for evaluating the RNA-to-RNA noise ceiling.

training.internal_val_split: 85/15 stratified by inner-training ATAC cluster for Stage 1 InfoNCE and Stage 2 MLP early stopping
training.convergence_check: log full epoch loss histories for Stage 1 validation InfoNCE and Stage 2 validation MSE and verify convergence prior to scoring; refit final model on all 7288 development cells alone before predicting 3124 held-out ATAC cells

validation.gene_claim_rule: Score all models and comparators on identical outer-fold unseen cells against unsmoothed binomial-thinned log-normalised RNA half B with identical zero-variance handling (r=0 if zero variance), sanity-checking each baseline first. Partition all 11282 frozen in-scope genes: (0) unjudgeable if RNA-to-RNA noise_ceiling fails to beat the 1000-shuffle cell-permutation null; (2) reliably_predicted_beyond_cell_type if judgeable, candidate aggregate mean r beats floor_3_depth and floor_2_gene_activity, complexity gain over simple_reference exceeds cross-seed spread, and 2000-draw fold-stratified paired-bootstrap gain (r_model - r_floor1 > 0) passes Benjamini-Hochberg at 5% FDR across all 11282 in-scope genes; (1) not_beyond_cell_type otherwise.

metrics: Mean and median per-gene Pearson r against binomial-thinned log-normalised RNA (half B) and paired-bootstrap correlation gain (Delta_r) over floor_1_cell_type across unseen cells

Empirical two-sided 95% paired-bootstrap confidence intervals (2000 resamples) for per-gene r and gain over floor_1_cell_type across all 11282 in-scope genes, plus interval width and cross-fold coverage diagnostics
Counts and gene identities partitioned into unjudgeable, not-beyond-cell-type, and reliably-predicted-beyond-cell-type groups at 5% BH-FDR across all 11282 in-scope genes
Ratio of achieved per-gene Pearson r to the RNA-to-RNA noise_ceiling across judgeable in-scope genes
Within-cluster Pearson r per gene (across inner-fit ATAC clusters and post-hoc descriptive WNN development cell types) alongside pooled r to audit rare populations down to 15 Plasma cells
Cross-seed and cross-fold variance of selection metrics plus Stage 1 InfoNCE and Stage 2 MLP training/validation convergence curves
P5.allowed_conclusions: Entitled to conclude exactly one of the four objective-defined options strictly for unseen granulocyte-depleted PBMCs of this single healthy donor under the same 10x Multiome assay: (1) unjudgeable due to measurement noise if no gene's ceiling beats the permutation null; (2) confounded by sequencing depth if aggregate mean r fails to beat floor_3_depth; (3) no gene predicted beyond cell identity if technical floors are beaten but zero judgeable genes beat floor_1_cell_type at 5% BH-FDR; or (4) specific identified genes are reliably predicted beyond cell identity at 5% BH-FDR. No claims are permitted regarding other donors, tissues, granulocytes, disease states, or causal regulation.
P5.rationale: Single-gene sparsity (D1) corrupts direct regression, whereas whole-cell InfoNCE alignment captures fine intra-cluster transcriptional state before readout (D6). Unit-sphere projection without depth curbs technical confounding (D5), and ATAC cluster reweighting preserves rare subtypes (D2) without joint-label leakage (D4).

P6.name: Gene-Adaptive Multi-Mechanism Chromatin Stacking Ensemble
P6.summary: We combine four complementary models via nested out-of-fold per-gene ridge stacking: an ATAC cluster-mean anchor, a cluster-residual MLP, a proximal 100kb cis-peak masked network, and a low-rank gene-embedding multitask network. All representations, clusters, early-stopped neural fits, and meta-weights are learned strictly inside outer training folds and scored against binomial-thinned RNA across three 3-fold seeds. Paired-bootstrap comparisons against technical, ceiling, and cluster-mean rulers at 5% FDR determine which genes are predicted beyond cell identity.
P6.analysis_unit: single cell (individual nucleus from the single healthy PBMC donor)
preprocessing: Strictly inside each outer training split (and on all 7,288 development cells alone for the final refit), select top 80,000 and top 25,000 peaks by binary accessibility frequency, compute TF-IDF weights on binarised peaks, and fit 101-component truncated SVD dropping component 1 to retain 100 depth-orthogonal LSI components.

Fit k=20 ATAC baseline clusters (frozen development k) on outer-training LSI coordinates only and assign unseen inner, outer-validation, and held-out cells to nearest training centroids without refitting.

Compute depth-normalised promoter-and-distal gene activity across the 11,282 frozen in-scope genes, extract up to 15 proximal peaks within +/-100 kb of each gene start site from peak-to-gene annotations, and z-score log1p ATAC fragment depth using outer-training statistics.

Normalise outer-training raw RNA UMI counts via 10,000-count library scaling and log1p transformation with no smoothing; split each unseen outer-validation cell's raw UMIs via independent binomial thinning (p=0.5) per seed into log1p-normalised halves A (ceiling input) and B (scoring target), excluding held-out cells from all fitting and WNN labels from all model inputs and truth.

training.convergence_audit: Log epoch-wise training and 10% inner-validation MSE curves for all three neural members across OOF and full-split refits, confirm validation loss convergence before max_epochs, fit GCV-tuned per-gene ridge weights on unsmoothed OOF predictions, and refit all four members on 100% of outer-training cells.

validation.gene_claim_rule: Verify all comparators on known-answer checks first, then evaluate candidate, constituent members, ceiling, null, and floors on identical unseen outer-fold cells, identical thinned RNA half B, all 11,282 frozen genes, and identical zero-variance handling (r=0). Place genes whose ceiling fails the 95th percentile of the 1,000-shuffle cell-permutation null into Group 0 (unjudgeable). Require mean r to exceed floor_3_depth and floor_2_gene_activity and measure seed/fold spread against simple_reference. Among judgeable genes, test r(ensemble) > r(floor_1_cell_type) via 1,000 paired cell-bootstrap resamples, apply Benjamini-Hochberg across all 11,282 in-scope genes at 5% FDR to call Group 2 (reliably predicted beyond cell type), and place remaining judgeable genes in Group 1.

metrics: Per-gene Pearson correlation r against unsmoothed binomial-thinned log-normalised RNA (half B) and paired-bootstrap gain delta_r over floor_1_cell_type with two-sided empirical 95% confidence intervals for all 11,282 in-scope genes
Mean and median per-gene Pearson r plus across-seed and across-fold spread (mean +/- SD over 3 seeds x 3 folds) compared against simple_reference, single-member ablations, and floors 1-4
Counts and identities of genes assigned to unjudgeable, not-beyond-cell-type, and reliably-predicted-beyond-cell-type decision groups at 5% BH FDR
Ratio of achieved per-gene Pearson r to the RNA-to-RNA half-A-to-half-B noise ceiling across judgeable in-scope genes
Within-cluster Pearson r per gene across nested k=20 ATAC clusters and development-only descriptive WNN cell types (down to the 15-cell Plasma cluster) alongside pooled r
Empirical coverage and width of paired-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals across validation folds, plus learned per-gene ridge meta-weights across the four regulatory members
P6.allowed_conclusions: Select strictly one of the four pre-specified conclusion options (unjudgeable due to noise, confounded by sequencing depth, no gene predicted beyond cell identity, or specific identified genes predicted beyond cell identity at 5% BH FDR accompanied by a finite 3124x11282 log-normalised held-out prediction matrix and 95% intervals), scoped exclusively to unseen granulocyte-depleted PBMCs from this single healthy donor under the same Multiome assay with no generalisation to other donors, tissues, conditions, granulocytes, or causal regulation.
P6.rationale: No single inductive bias suits 11,282 genes facing 85% RNA zeros (D1) and strong cell-type baselines (D6). Per-gene out-of-fold ridge stacking lets noisy genes borrow low-rank module strength, dynamic genes combine proximal cis-peaks with rare-cluster-preserving residuals (D2), and static genes anchor on cluster means.

forbidden_reasons.Other query cells' RNA profiles or test-: The question conditions on one cell's RNA profile alone; bipartite matching across queries exploits mutual exclusion rather than single-cell retrieval.
forbidden_reasons.Evaluation RNA or ATAC profiles smoothed: Cross-cell smoothing leaks graph neighborhood structure across test cells and masks single-cell dropout noise, overstating individual-cell retrieval accuracy.
forbidden_reasons.Evaluation-split cells during feature se: Fitting preprocessing, embeddings, or hyperparameters on evaluation cells leaks test-set structure and biases out-of-sample retrieval estimates upward.
forbidden_reasons.Candidate cells' held-out or paired RNA: Candidates represent ATAC profiles only; accessing candidate RNA reduces cross-modal retrieval to unimodal RNA-to-RNA matching.

plans.name: Nested 5-Fold Linear CCA on RNA PCA and Depth-Filtered ATAC LSI
plans.summary: We align paired single-cell RNA PCA and depth-filtered ATAC LSI spaces using linear canonical correlation analysis across five nested cell-level folds of the 7,288 development cells. Each unseen query RNA profile independently ranks ~1,458 unseen candidate ATAC profiles in its held-out fold by cosine similarity without cross-query matching or WNN labels. Paired-bootstrap MRR is compared against random, depth, gene-activity, and k=20 cluster floors alongside a split-half noise ceiling. This determines the resolution of global linear alignment and anchors all complex benchmarks.
plans.analysis_unit: Individual cell (single nucleus with co-measured RNA and ATAC in development splits)
preprocessing: Partition the 7,288 paired development cells into 5 disjoint outer folds (~1,458 cells/fold, seed=42) strictly by cell ID without using WNN annotations; split each outer training set (85% inner-train, 15% inner-val) by cell ID for hyperparameter selection.

RNA per-cell preprocessing and projection: restrict to the 11,282 frozen in-scope genes, normalise per-cell UMI counts to CP10K and apply log1p (no cross-cell smoothing), z-score genes using inner-train mean/std, and fit 64-component truncated PCA strictly on inner-train cells with inner-train component standardization.

ATAC LSI preprocessing and projection: select top 50,000 peaks ranked by nonzero cell frequency in inner-train only, binarise counts, compute per-cell TF multiplied by inner-train IDF, fit 65-component truncated SVD on inner-train, drop component 1 (technical sequencing depth) to retain 64 LSI components, and standardize using inner-train mean/std.

Freeze all scalers, IDF weights, PCA/SVD bases, k=20 ATAC cluster centroids, and peak-to-gene sums on each outer training fold before projecting unseen outer-fold query RNA and candidate ATAC profiles.

training.inner_tuning: Grid-search cca_latent n_components over [15, 30, 50, 64] across 3 inner-validation resamples; measure selection spread across resamples and select the smallest n_components within 1 SE of peak inner-val MRR (Lesson K1), then refit on the full outer training fold and log singular-value spectrum check.

comparators_on_identical_splits: Floor 0 (permutation null): uniform random ranking of each outer fold's candidate ATAC pool verified against analytical harmonic expectation.
Floor 1 (sequencing depth): rank unseen candidate ATAC profiles by closeness to inner-train OLS-predicted log1p ATAC fragment count from query log1p RNA UMI count.
Floor 2 (unlearned gene activity): cosine similarity between query log1p(CP10K) RNA and candidate promoter_and_distal log1p(CP10K) ATAC gene-activity sums across in-scope genes.

Exact top-1 retrieval rate (Recall@1), Recall@5, and Recall@10 across unseen query cells.

plans.rationale: Dropping the first LSI component removes technical depth confounding (D5), while five-fold out-of-sample evaluation scores every cell including rare types like the 15 Plasma cells (D2). plans.name: Hard-Negative Dual-View Contrastive Bi-Encoder with Depth Deconfounding
plans.summary: We train paired residual neural encoders with symmetric InfoNCE contrastive loss to retrieve an unseen cell's unsmoothed ATAC profile from its RNA counts alone. The ATAC encoder combines sparse TF-IDF peaks and promoter-and-distal gene activity while penalizing sequencing-depth shortcuts. Training uses binomial thinning, unsupervised inverse-cluster weighting, and an intra-cluster hard-negative batch curriculum fitted strictly on inner-training cells. Benchmarking on held-out queries (and an expanded 4,946-cell distractor pool) against required floors, linear CCA, and split-half ceilings determines whether retrieval exceeds cluster resolution.

Restrict RNA counts to the 11,282 in-scope genes; apply per-cell library-size normalization (CP10k) and log1p, then standardize per gene using mean and standard deviation fitted strictly on inner_train.
Select the top 40,000 accessible ATAC peaks strictly on inner_train; compute sparse TF-IDF using inner_train IDF weights followed by per-cell L2 normalization.

Aggregate ATAC counts into promoter_and_distal gene_activity over the 11,282 in-scope genes via the 87,029 peak-gene links, normalize by per-cell ATAC depth, apply log1p, and standardize using inner_train statistics.

Standardize per-cell log RNA UMI depth and log ATAC fragment depth using inner_train statistics solely for training-time depth-orthogonality regularization, depth-leakage auditing, and the Floor 1 comparator.

Fit unsupervised k=30 k-means on concatenated inner_train RNA PCA(50) and ATAC LSI(50) strictly within inner_train to compute inverse-square-root cluster sample weights and intra-cluster hard-negative neighborhoods without touching WNN annotations.

plan.name: Inductive Cluster-Balanced Coupled Variational Autoencoder (MultiVI)
plan.summary: We train an inductive paired-modality variational autoencoder (MultiVI) strictly on training cells' raw RNA counts and 25,000 ATAC peaks, aligning modality-specific posteriors while separating sequencing depth from biological state. For unseen ATAC-only cells, posterior-predictive decoding imputes library-normalised log expression without test-set leakage or WNN labels. Across three nested 75/25 splits scored on binomial-thinned RNA half B, we compare against depth, gene-activity, linear, and 20-cluster baselines plus the noise ceiling. Paired bootstraps at 5% FDR identify genes predictable beyond cell identity.
plan.analysis_unit: single cell (individual nucleus from the single healthy PBMC donor)
preprocessing: Strictly inside each outer training split (and on the 7288 development cells alone for the final fit), select the top 25000 ATAC peaks detected in 0.5% to 85% of training cells, breaking ties toward peak-to-gene linked loci; extract binarised/fragment counts and log ATAC depth without touching outer-validation or held-out cells.

Retain training cells' raw paired RNA UMI counts across all 13536 measured genes for MultiVI Negative Binomial generative modelling so library-size proportions sum properly before slicing decoded predictions to the 11282 frozen in-scope genes.

Inside each outer training split only, compute depth-dropped 50-D LSI (over all 108377 peaks), k=20 ATAC clusters (frozen baseline count), and promoter-plus-distal gene activity solely to fit required baseline comparators and compute inverse-sqrt ATAC-cluster training weights plus stratified 90/10 inner early-stopping splits.

For unseen outer-validation cells only at scoring time, split raw RNA UMIs once per seed via independent Binomial(n, 0.5) thinning into halves A and B, normalise each half to 10000 total counts across measured genes, apply log1p, slice to the 11282 frozen in-scope genes, and reserve half B exclusively as the unsmoothed scoring target.

Never include outer-validation or held-out ATAC profiles during MultiVI training, peak filtering, or hyperparameter selection, and never use curated WNN cell-type labels as inputs, stratification variables, or evaluation truth.

plan.name: State-Gated Long-Range Cis-Enhancer Attention and Low-Rank Gene-Factor Network
plan.summary: We model chromatin-to-RNA regulation beyond cell identity using a state-gated cis-enhancer and low-rank gene-factor network. Global LSI state attends over eight distance-resolved cis-peak heads within 500 kb per gene and fuses them with shared gene embeddings above soft ATAC-cluster anchors and isolated depth offsets. Strictly nested 5-fold cross-validation trains with cluster-balanced residual loss and scores against unsmoothed thinned RNA. Paired bootstrap tests at 5% FDR identify genes predicted beyond cell identity in this donor.
plan.analysis_unit: single cell (individual nucleus from the single healthy PBMC donor)
preprocessing: Split development cells via unconditioned cell-level 5-fold partitions so zero global transformation, scaling, or clustering touches evaluation cells (A2)

Inside each outer training fold, fit binarised TF-IDF and 65-component truncated SVD across all 108,377 peaks, drop component 1 (depth-correlated), and z-score the remaining 64 LSI components; project validation/held-out ATAC strictly out-of-sample

Fit frozen-count k=20 k-means on inner-training 64D LSI to define Floor 1 hard clusters, soft Gaussian-kernel cluster responsibilities, and inverse-sqrt cluster cell weights (clipped at 5x median weight); never use curated WNN labels in fitting (A1, D4)
Standardize log1p total ATAC fragment depth on inner-training cells and compute within-cluster centered log-depth for orthogonalization diagnostics (D5)

Extract up to 40 annotated/proximal peaks within +/-500 kb of each of the 11,282 frozen in-scope gene TSS coordinates (ranked by TSS proximity and inner-training accessibility), build sparse peak-to-gene incidence indices with 8D static genomic link features (6 log-distance radial basis functions, upstream/downstream sign, promoter/distal flag), and log1p-depth-normalise peak and promoter-only gene-activity counts using inner-training scalers

On inner-training cells only, average 8 independent Binomial(UMI, 0.5) draws transformed by log1p(10000 * counts / library_size) to form single-cell variance-reduced targets calibrated to the exact half-depth evaluation scale without cross-cell smoothing (A3, A8)

training.convergence_audit: Log per-epoch train/inner-val loss components and unsmoothed thinned-half residual r; require finite monotonic-trend inner-val stabilization before scoring (K3, K4)

validation.comparator_sanity_checks: Verify permutation_null centers near 0, floor_3_depth uses 1 covariate, floor_1_cell_type is piecewise constant over k=20 ATAC clusters, and ceiling maps training half A to half B before scoring unseen half A against unseen half B on identical cells and zero-variance rules (A4, K8)
validation.gene_claim_rule: Across 1,000 fold-stratified paired cell-bootstrap resamples of unseen outer-fold predictions (pooled over 5 folds and averaged across 2 seeds, checking seed spread per K1), compute empirical two-sided 95% CIs for r_g and delta_r_g = r_g(model) - r_g(floor_1_cell_type). Assign genes whose ceiling fails to beat permutation_null at 5% BH-FDR to Group 0 (unjudgeable); test remaining genes via one-sided paired-bootstrap p-values for delta_r_g > 0 with Benjamini-Hochberg across all 11,282 in-scope genes at 5% FDR to assign Group 2 (reliably_predicted_beyond_cell_type) vs Group 1 (not_beyond_cell_type) (A6, A7)

metrics: Primary: Mean per-gene Pearson r against unsmoothed binomial-thinned log-normalised RNA (half B) and paired-bootstrap delta_r gain over floor_1_cell_type with 95% CIs across all 11,282 frozen in-scope genes
Secondary: Gene counts and identities in Group 0 (unjudgeable), Group 1 (not_beyond_cell_type), and Group 2 (reliably_predicted_beyond_cell_type) at 5% BH-FDR
Secondary: Ratio of achieved per-gene Pearson r to the RNA-to-RNA noise ceiling across judgeable in-scope genes
Secondary: Within-cluster per-gene Pearson r across all 20 ATAC clusters and post-hoc descriptive WNN cell types (including rare n=15 Plasma cells) alongside pooled r on development splits (D2, K7)
Secondary: Empirical width and cross-fold calibration of paired-bootstrap 95% CIs, learned cis-vs-trans gate summaries, and automated A1-A8 acceptance check pass/fail audit (K5)
plan.allowed_conclusions: Map results strictly to the four objective conclusion options: (1) unjudgeable if no gene's ceiling beats permutation_null; (2) confounded by depth if judgeable genes exist but aggregate mean r fails to beat floor_3_depth (or floor_2_gene_activity for biological claims); (3) no gene predicted beyond cell identity if technical floors are beaten (and complexity over simple_reference/floor_4_simple_learners exceeds seed/bootstrap spread) yet zero judgeable genes beat floor_1_cell_type at 5% BH-FDR; (4) specific genes predicted beyond cell identity for the exact 5%-FDR Group 2 gene set, accompanied by the refitted 3,124 x 11,282 finite log-normalised held-out prediction matrix. Scope applies strictly to unseen granulocyte-depleted PBMCs from this single healthy donor under this Multiome assay, with no claims about other donors, tissues, diseases, granulocytes, or causal regulation.
plan.rationale: Distal enhancers within 500 kb drive within-lineage expression conditionally on trans-chromatin state, motivating state-gated cis attention over static masks (D6). Low-rank gene embeddings counter 85% RNA sparsity (D1), while cluster-balanced residual training protects rare populations (D2) and depth orthogonalization prevents technical confounding (D5).

new_components.name: context_gated_cis_lowrank_net
new_components.description: Computes single-cell log-normalised expression predictions for all G=11,282 in-scope genes by adding a state-gated cis-enhancer and bilinear low-rank trans-factor residual to a soft ATAC-cluster baseline and isolated depth offset. Inputs: 64D LSI vector z_i, standardized log-depth d_i, centered promoter activity p_i (G), and sparse cis-peak accessibility links (<=40 peaks within +/-500 kb per gene) with 8D static TSS-distance/orientation/promoter-distal features. Forward pass: (1) soft-cluster kernel responsibilities over k=20 inner-training LSI centroids multiply training cluster means to give anchor b_{i,g}, plus ridge-penalized depth term beta_g * d_i; (2) a genomic-edge MLP maps link metadata and learned gene embeddings E (G x 48) to H=8 normalized regulatory-head weights per gene, aggregating cell peak counts via sparse scatter/spmm into S_{i,g,h} (B x G x 8); (3) a 2-layer LayerNorm-GELU trans MLP maps z_i to H scaled-dot-product attention queries Q_{i,h} (interacting with gene keys K_{g,h} to gate S_{i,g,h} + w_g * p_{i,g} into cis signal c_{i,g}) and to 48D trans factors u_i (dot-multiplied with gene-embedding projections V_g into low-rank module signal t_{i,g}); (4) per-gene learned gate gamma_g combines s_g * (gamma_g * c_{i,g} + (1 - gamma_g) * t_{i,g}) with b_{i,g} + beta_g * d_i. Outputs: finite (B x 11,282) log-normalised expression matrix. Training: AdamW with cosine warmup, early stopping on inner 15% split, optimizing inverse-sqrt ATAC-cluster-weighted MSE plus batchwise residual cosine loss and within-cluster depth-orthogonality penalty against inner-training half-depth expected log1p RNA.
